main_text.p: ab eorum servitute eximimur, sive cum à peccatis ad serviendum Deo vivo convertimur, Heb. 9. 14. Utraq; hæc purgatio in nobis est necessario conjuncta, 1.Corint. 6. 10.11. Sed non tollit purgationem per sanguinem.

Causæ hujus purgationis, de quâ hic, tres observari possunt. Prima exprimitur v. 9. nempe liberalis Dei benignitas, quâ ipse nullis nostris meritis provocatus, veniam omnium peccatorum ultrò nobis offert, si modò in Christum credamus ac respiscamus. Hic ipse se debitorem quodammodo nobis constituit, ac proinde pro sua æquitate ac fidelitate promissum præstat: Fidelis est ac justus Deus, ut remittat nobis peccata nostra, & purget nos ab omni iniquitate.Causa purgationis prima in Epist. Iohannis.

2. Altera causa exprimitur v. 7. nempe Sanguis Christi Filii Dei, qui tamen hic ꝑ[?] tota Christi oblatione, per quâ peccata expiantur, accipi debet. Mentio-ne interim Sanguinis & Mortis Christi, in purgationis hujus doctrinâ, velut cō-pendio quodam, nobis ob oculos ponitur Immensa Dei & Christi erga nosCausa secunda.

page.notes: The printed page number at the top left is partly damaged; read as 192 with doubt. The small sign before "tota" (ꝑ[?]) is unclear and may be a printer's mark or abbreviation. The catchword "Cari-" is at the lower right. Reference marks and italics in the references are as printed. The text is in roman with italic quotations and references; no Greek or Hebrew appears on this page. Long s is set as s throughout.
